success-check.description: Circle draws, fills, and a check mark draws on: success, done, confirmed.

error-x.description: Red disc pops, an X draws and shakes: error, failed, rejected.

warning-pulse.description: Warning triangle with a pulsing ring: attention, risk, alert.

info-pop.description: Soft disc pops and an info mark draws: tip, note, information.

loading-spinner.description: Arc spinning around a soft track: loading, processing, working.

dots-loader.description: Three dots bouncing in sequence: waiting, thinking, loading.

bars-loader.description: Four bars pulsing up and down: audio, activity, processing.

progress-ring.description: Ring fills all the way round: progress, completion, 100%.

pulse-ring.description: Rings ripple out from a dot: live, broadcasting, active.

radar-ping.description: Dot with an expanding ping: location found, signal, online.

badge-pop.description: Verified badge pops with a spark burst: verified, approved, quality.

star-burst.description: Gold star pops with rays: rating, favourite, top pick.

confetti-burst.description: Confetti bursts out and falls: celebration, launch, win.

sparkle-twinkle.description: Three sparkles twinkle in turn: magic, AI, new, premium.

fireworks.description: Two firework bursts: celebration, milestone, success.

heart-like.description: Heart fills and pops with a ring: like, love, favourite.

cursor-click.description: Cursor glides in and clicks with a ripple: click, select, try it.

button-press.description: Button presses and its label becomes a check: submit, buy, confirm.

toggle-on.description: Switch slides on and turns colour: enable, activate, turn on.

checkbox-tick.description: Checkbox fills and ticks: task done, selected, agreed.

typing-dots.description: Chat bubble with typing dots: replying, AI answering, chat.

notification-bell.description: Bell rings and a badge dot pops: notification, reminder, alert.

search-scan.description: Magnifier sweeps over content: search, discover, find.

upload-arrow.description: Arrow rises out of a tray: upload, publish, send data.

download-arrow.description: Arrow drops into a tray: download, receive, import.

refresh-spin.description: Refresh arrows spin: sync, update, retry, automation.

cart-add.description: A box drops into a cart that bounces, badge pops: add to cart, order.

card-swipe.description: Card slides in and gets a success tick: card payment accepted.

coin-stack.description: Three coins drop and stack: savings, revenue, earnings, rewards.

payment-success.description: Card icon with a success badge: payment confirmed, paid.

package-drop.description: Parcel drops in and squashes on landing: shipped, packed, order ready.

gift-bounce.description: Gift shakes, then pops with sparkles: reward, offer, surprise.

truck-drive.description: Delivery truck bobbing with speed lines: shipping, on the way.

map-pin-drop.description: Pin drops onto the map with a ripple: location, destination, store.

route-draw.description: A dashed route draws from start to a destination pin: journey, tracking.

delivery-done.description: Parcel slides to the door, check badge pops: delivered.

receipt-print.description: Receipt slides up and gets a tick: invoice, order summary, billing.

price-tag.description: Price tag swings on its hook: pricing, discount, sale.

bars-grow.description: Bars grow from a baseline one after another: growth, results, metrics.

line-chart-draw.description: A rising line chart draws and marks its peak: trend, performance.

pie-fill.description: Donut chart fills in three segments: share, breakdown, allocation.

trend-up.description: Trending-up arrow draws and lifts: growth, increase, ROI.

gauge-needle.description: Gauge fills and the needle swings high: score, speed, performance.

shield-check.description: Shield draws, a check appears, it pulses: secure, protected, safe.

lock-secure.description: Padlock drops in with a green pulse: locked, encrypted, private.

fingerprint-scan.description: Fingerprint with a scanning line: biometric, identity, sign in.

gear-spin.description: Two gears turning together: settings, automation, integration.

cloud-sync.description: Cloud with spinning sync arrows: cloud backup, syncing, SaaS.

rocket-launch.description: Rocket shakes and launches with a trail: launch, go live, boost.

ai-sparkle.description: Wand with twinkling sparkles: AI, magic, auto-generate.

send-plane.description: Paper plane pulls back and shoots off with a trail: send, share, deliver.

mail-arrive.description: Envelope slides in and a badge dot pops: new email, message received.

chat-pop.description: Two chat bubbles pop in turn: conversation, support, messaging.

phone-ring.description: Phone vibrates with call waves: call, support line, contact.

clock-tick.description: Clock hands sweep round: time saved, scheduling, speed.

hourglass-flip.description: Hourglass waits, then flips: waiting, time running, deadline.

calendar-check.description: Calendar with a check drawing on: booked, scheduled, confirmed date.

users-join.description: People pop in one after another: team, community, sign-ups.
